title: RegisterInput
description: Policy input for evaluating a new user registration request.

email.description: Optional email address provided during registration

requester.description: Information about the entity making this request

RegistrationMethod.description: How the user account registration was initiated.

oneOf.description: Registration via an upstream OAuth 2.0 identity provider

Requester.description: Metadata about the entity making a policy-evaluated request.

ip_address.description: IP address of the entity making the request, when available

user_agent.description: HTTP User-Agent header value, when available

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code derived from the IP address
